apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store IDs (e.g. 284882215), App Store URLs, or app names. A name is resolved to the top search result in the first country.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes. Reviews differ per country storefront.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app and country
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Apple's feed serves at most the 500 most recent reviews per app and country.

since.title: Only reviews on or after
since.description: ISO date (e.g. 2026-11-01). With 'Most recent' the run stops paging once older reviews appear, so daily monitoring stays cheap.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep reviews with at least this many stars.

maxRating.title: Maximum rating
maxRating.description: Keep reviews with at most this many stars (e.g. 2 for complaints only).
